description: Land Acquisition - Riloluwa, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of 104 land lots with their boundaries, extents, and claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related declarations.
